These options are accepted by every command in the tree.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `-v, --verbose` | flag | `false` | no | Show detailed error output and stack traces |

`--help` and `--version` are supplied by the command-line host.

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--help`, `-h`, `-?` | Show help for the command and exit. |
| `--version` | Show the tool version and exit. |
